name: qkd_static_kv_return_slots_mc_r3
slot_change_request: Official local pin grant d61fc4215; candidate only. Whole-die static boundary homes and integration remain open.

job.purpose: Four actual independent phase-aligned pll_hbm_data storage roots: fixed bit slices replace a single >15k storage root; no clock gating, no timing exception between same-phase roots, no normal-cycle delta. Front width259.2 removes measured66.4% utilization failure. | mc3b (Q-ELEM 10-16): mc3-9196b2eb1 EARLY_FAIL_HOLD at CTS: the only failing endpoint was idle_hbm (setup -527 / hold -90 ps): raw controller_co[0]/compiled_hbm_put pins fed the idle compare, and idle_hbm was constrained as a core_clk output. Fix: idle_hbm from registered pin captures only (+1 pll_hbm edge on the drain observation, no schedule use) and idle_hbm in the hclk output set. | mc3c (Q-ELEM-RING 10-16): mc3b-d4c0e5fee CLOSED (TT +68.38 / FF +25.64, DRC 0) but the native pin audit FAILS. (1) capture 259.3 ps on expected_put: measured routed cone expected_put -> INV -> AND5 -> AND4 -> idle_core flop at the N face (~330 um from the E-face pin, 250 ps of logic+wire; the slot flop itself sits at the pin) -> RTL: idle_core / idle_hbm from registered terms only, exactly the original observation one local edge later (+1 ck / +1 pll_hbm edge on the drain observations, no schedule use; the r3b idle_hbm missed the put on the edge itself - fixed). (2) launch 221.1 ps on actual_data[3]: routed path ot_prs pin flop -> 3 HB2 hold cells (2 added by the post-route hold ECO, pre-ECO designed output FF hold slack +9.6 ps < the ECO's 30 ps margin) -> pin; the designed output pad is now HB4 (+21 ps FF, out of the ECO window), expected TT launch ~176-180 ps.

hold_pad.basis: mc3b-d4c0e5fee routed FF: output hold slack with the HB2 out pad alone +9.6 ps (actual_data[3]) / +11.3 (actual_sector[0]); the 30 ps hold ECO then added 1-2 HB2 per output (TT launch 221.1). HB4-HB2 = +21 ps FF / +25 ps TT.
